name: Venomancer: Charm of Warding heals on every Exposed Flesh application at the 10-stack cap (#9721, #10649)
contract: #9721/#10649: players with Charm of Warding (705967) saw no heal while tanking. Tooltip (client and server
Spell.dbc, AscensionDB/SUB): 'When a stack of Exposed Flesh is applied you are now healed for $s1% of your maximum
health' ($s1 = 1). The native data heals on every application (805095 Effect2 -> 806606 HEAL_PCT, raised by the
talent's SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), including a refresh at the cap; CoA's Expose() healed only when the count rose, so a
tank at 10 stacks never healed. Here Exposed Flesh is pinned at its cap of 10 (StackAmount) while four attackers
hit the Beetle Form Venomancer; each hit proc (805098, 50% per hit, 1 s internal cooldown) refreshes the capped
aura and must log a Charm of Warding heal. Trials: four attackers swing about twice per second, so each 1 s window
misses a proc with probability about 0.25; fewer than 2 procs in the 12 s window is below 1e-5. Control: before
the talent is learned the same hits log no Charm of Warding heal.

steps.label: SETUP: the attackers are in combat
CONTROL: no Charm of Warding heal without the talent
SETUP: Charm of Warding is active
Pin Exposed Flesh at its cap
SETUP: Exposed Flesh is at 10 stacks
DISCRIMINATING: refreshes at the cap log Charm of Warding heals
Exposed Flesh stayed at its cap while healing
